Our Story: Passion in Every Play

At AKS Cricket, we believe that every player deserves gear that matches their ambition.

Founded in 2016 right here in Malaga, our journey began with a simple love for the game and a mission to provide Australian cricketers with world-class equipment. What started as a local passion project has since grown into a trusted destination for players across the country, from weekend warriors to seasoned pros.

We aren't just retailers; we’re students of the game. We understand the weight of the perfect bat, the grip of a fresh pair of gloves, and the confidence that comes with high-quality protection. That’s why we hand-select every piece of gear in our shop to ensure it meets our standards for performance and durability.

  • Find Us: 5/10 Stanford Way, Malaga, WA
  • Get in Touch: admin@aks.com.au

AKS Cricket—Gear up. Play on.
